samples.question: The chart shows five colored bars standing on one common baseline: red, orange, green, blue and purple, in some left-to-right order. The horizontal gray gridlines are exactly one unit apart, so a bar's value is its height measured in gridline units. Bar widths and bar positions carry no information. Read the bars from left to right and keep a running total of their values. The crossing bar is the first bar at which this running total reaches at least half of the total of all five bars. Which color is the crossing bar? Answer red, orange, green, blue or purple.
